Zoe: that surprise sparkler outro was delightfully chaotic 386; my keyboard is sticky from clapping too hard
Marcus: noted: bring fire extinguisher to next all-hands? :laughing:
Priya: also big props to infra for zero regressions demo 44f; felt polished
Dan: can we get the sparkler moment as a loop for the new screensaver? 
Kelsey: 100% yes. making it into a tiny gif rn -> https://img.redwood/gifs/sparkler_clip (will upload)
Zoe: quick poll  post-all-hands meetup snacks: cupcakes or charcuterie? reply 'cupcakes' or 'charcuterie'
Marcus: charcuterie (cheese solves everything)
Priya: cupcakes. frosting is life 
Dan: cupcakes for the MVP sugar boost
Kelsey: charcuterie if there are olives involved :olives:
allhands-bot: Recording and transcript uploaded: https://redwood.example/ah/1745551111 (auto-post)
confetti-bot: dropped "tiny_confetti.gif" in thread :tada:
Zoe: bonus challenge: office photo for the new hallway collage, who's in for 6:05pm lobby?
Marcus: count me in, i'll practice my dramatic smize
Priya: will be there, bringing the team's slightly awkward energy
Dan: scanning calendar now, probably in. if not, i send my cardboard cutout :cut_of_meat:
Kelsey: if cupcakes win, i'll bake a batch. if charcuterie wins, i'll assemble a dangerously fancy board
Zoe: tally: cupcakes 2, charcuterie 2  tie means both? compromise: mini cupcakes + meat/cheese nibbles
Marcus: compromise accepted. i love a two-tier snack strategy
Priya: shoutout to @Design for the slick slides and to the intern who animated the sparkles 389
Dan: shoutout to the person who fixed the mic five minutes before we started. legend.
Kelsey: posted the sparkler gif to #memes -> https://files.redwood/memes/sparkles.gif
Zoe: someone please clip the mic-fix hero moment for posterity, we need a medal emoji next to their name on Slack
allhands-bot: Feedback form reminder: two minutes left to submit. Thanks for the energy! :sparkles:
Marcus: ok team, see you at the lobby. remember: dramatic smize and snack diplomacy
Priya: bringing tiny flags for the hallway photo because why not
Dan: bringing a cardboard cutout just in case :joy:
